ip.label: Router IP address
ip.help: IP address of your Deco router (usually 192.168.68.1)

password.label: Router admin password
password.help: The same password you use to log in to the Deco app or web UI

interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
interval.help: How often the adapter reads client data from the router (minimum 10 s)

keepDisconnected.label: Keep disconnected clients
keepDisconnected.help: When enabled, clients that have left the network remain visible with connected = false
